title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Trường Trung học Quốc gia tại Barangay Tuburan, Đô thị Pototan, Tỉnh Iloilo, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติ ในบารังไกย์ Tuburan เทศบาล Pototan จังหวัด Iloilo และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้

text.en: There is hereby established a national high school in Barangay Tuburan, Pototan, Iloilo, to be named as the Jose Facultad Memorial National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports is hereby directed to take such measures as are necessary to establish the Jose Facultad Memorial National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
